messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm about to tag v1.12.0-rc3 and push artifacts. Who owns the S3 path + checksum upload today?
leo: I can take S3 upload. Which bucket/path?
maria: use s3://redwood-releases/prod/v1.12.0/rc3/. Upload artifacts + checksums and put a sha256 file for each binary.
sam: heads-up CI had one intermittent failure on macos build last run, but binaries look sane. I re-ran the job.
maria: thanks. Also we should make the annotated tag message include changelog highlights + CVE note for the connector. Example: `git tag -a v1.12.0-rc3 -m "v1.12.0-rc3\nChangelog: metric batching fix, connect CVE mitigation"`
jess: small ask — can we include the build metadata stamp in the tag body: `build=2026-03-15+sha7f3a2`? Makes debugging easier.
leo: will add the build stamp to the artifacts metadata files too. Doing upload now.
release-bot: [artifact-upload] uploads complete: binaries(4) -> s3://redwood-releases/prod/v1.12.0/rc3/ :white_check_mark: 1999998894
maria: OK next — who will create the GitHub draft release and attach the assets? I can make the draft but want another +1 before publishing.
sam: I can attach and draft. Maria, please drop the changelog bullets you want in the body here.
maria: paste changelog: - fix latency regression in batched encoder - rollback connector 2.1 default flag - add metrics for kv cache hit-rate
jess: LGTM. Also add a note under Known Issues: "canary autoscale may overshoot under burst for first 30m" so support is ready.
ops-bot: [notice] please ensure GPG signing is done for annotated tags if publishing official release.
maria: good point — do we sign rc tags? We usually sign final. For RC we can sign if available. Who has the signing key?
leo: I have access to the release GPG on my laptop. I can do a signed tag if we decide.
sam: let's skip signing for RC but flag the candidate for final sign-off.
maria: OK plan: leo uploads artifacts+checksums (done), sam will create the GH draft and attach assets (1999998898), I will create annotated local tag and push `git push origin refs/tags/v1.12.0-rc3` once draft is attached, still holding publish until +1 from jess.
jess: +1 for publish flow. I'll be on standby for the final click. :thumbsup:
release-bot: [draft-created] GitHub draft release created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v1.12.0-rc3 1999998900
sam: attached binaries and checksum files. Dropped a short release note and the changelog maria posted.
maria: pushing tag now: `git tag -a v1.12.0-rc3 -m "v1.12.0-rc3\nbuild=2026-03-15+sha7f3a2\nChangelog: ..." && git push origin v1.12.0-rc3`
leo: saw the tag. Also uploaded signature file for the build metadata (not GPG).
jess: reviewing draft now. small nit: reorder changelog bullets to highlight the latency fix first.
maria: done. re-uploaded updated draft body.
jess: ready to publish once we confirm no blocking CI failures in the last 12h.
sam: CI green on all release-related pipelines as of 1999998904.
maria: publishing in 5 unless objections.
leo: no objections from me.
jess: go for it. :party:
maria: published release and annotated tag pushed. tagging note: remember to add entry to the release checklist that deployment playbook is updated.
release-bot: [publish] release v1.12.0-rc3 published (draft -> release) 1999998905
maria: thanks everyone. I'll file a small follow-up to remind on signing final.
